ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  Alkali Metals Limited's 58th Annual General Meeting will address routine business including the adoption of FY2025-26 financial statements and a proposed Rs. 1 per share dividend. Materially, shareholders will vote on the re-appointment of the Managing Director and the appointment of an Executive Director, both with substantial remuneration packages, including a 10% annual increment and a "minimum remuneration" clause ensuring high pay regardless of profitability, which warrants investor scrutiny. The company is also appointing an Independent Director and facilitating a fully virtual meeting with e-voting in line with modern governance standards.
